name: Shader Upscale for Vestra Player
author: zysilm
punchline: Real-time GPU upscaling with mpv GLSL shaders: Anime4K for anime, AMD FSR 1 for everything else
description: Sharpens and enlarges the video on the GPU while it plays, with mpv shaders bundled in the plugin: Anime4K for anime (six modes, Fast or HQ) and AMD FSR 1 for live action and everything else, plus two add-ons, chroma upscaling (CfL) and adaptive sharpening. Video ▸ Shader Upscaling… opens a window to choose them, turn upscaling on and off, and see what is applied. Needs GPU rendering: macOS, or Windows with Video ▸ GPU Rendering (Experimental). Remembers your choice.
